decisions.decision: Build T-457 now in the os/ tree from T-454 (the one with os/scripts/api.mjs). Build five kits in os/kits/. (1) funnel/: a copy of cloud/funnel/worker.js plus config.schema.json taken from buildConfig in cloud/src/funnel.ts, a validate-config.mjs, an example Tantra config, and deploy.mjs. deploy.mjs calls wrangler through api.mjs and the vendor sim for sim_ keys. (2) deck/: a generator around buildDeck/renderDeck. (3) sequences/: Tantra draft-campaign JSON (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, reminders, nurture) created through api.mjs, which blocks launch. (4) crm/: GHL, HubSpot and Zoho build scripts. (5) equations/: a runner. Use only approved vendors and Backlinko copy. To finish, run a fresh `claude -p` session in a test attendee folder that writes a config from context and deploys it to the local or sim stack. The funnel must answer 200. Log the transcript as evidence, commit and push, then set review.
decisions.why: The plan (REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md, item 7 and the T-457 row) defines the work. The skeleton is done (T-454 in review). This is pure agent work on our own systems and needs no input from Adi.
